0022600002.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the New York Knicks host the Philadelphia 76ers. The 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, the Knicks won the 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, and their most recent meeting was a 144-114 Knicks win in Philadelphia on May 10, 2026. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Knicks a 55% chance to win, and Josh Hart is day-to-day with ankle soreness, while the 76ers are missing Ariel Hukporti (ruptured Achilles), Dominick Barlow (back) and Tacko Fall (hip), and Adem Bona (foot sprain), Anfernee Simons (hamstring) and Dean Wade (ankle sprain) are day-to-day.
